items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: like I went to a Beyonce and Jay-Z concert the other day

ctx.x: How do you learn to sort of take care of the bandstand, to present a concert? Because there’s more to it than just what you play.

Oh yeah. I mean it’s a lot of studying. I mean I believe that anyway. You know everyone’s different. But for me I like to study the greats. I like to study the people that I admire. Like you watch Miles Davis it’s like what do I like about that besides the playing part, besides everybody in the band that’s playing, but also when you watch these videos it’s like okay how does he direct the band? How does he present the music even though his back is turned sometimes? You know like how does that even work? Or you…
Do you have a drummer list, a bass player list, and you line up gigs and a tour and you’ve got to figure out who’s available?
